stories.title: TSMC employee data breach linked to cloud provider
stories.summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) confirmed that personal employee data has been leaked online after a threat actor put 6.9GB of information allegedly stolen from the company up for auction.
stories.why_it_matters: Potentially affected organizations and individuals should follow confirmed notifications, review exposed-data risk, and strengthen monitoring for follow-on fraud or credential abuse.

stories.title: FBI warns ARTEX AI hacking tool is powering global cyberattacks
stories.summary: The FBI is warning that hackers are using an AI-powered penetration testing framework called ARTEX to automate cyberattacks against organizations worldwide, including a recent ConnectWise supply-chain breach that compromised Microsoft 365 customer environments.
stories.why_it_matters: Security teams should review the original reporting, determine whether the development affects their environment, and adjust monitoring or controls when supported by verified details.

stories.title: Pentagon Renames CDAO ‘Super Intelligence Office’
stories.summary: The move follows President Trump’s order to replace “artificial intelligence” with “super intelligence” in executive branch communications.
stories.why_it_matters: Security and technology teams should assess the development for changes to model risk, data handling, access controls, and their existing AI governance.

stories.title: Italy Fines Meta €805 Million Over Facebook's Android Gallery Access Without Explicit Consent
stories.summary: Meta was fined €805 million in Italy yesterday over a Facebook for Android feature that suggests photos and videos from users' phone galleries for them to post.

stories.title: Cursor Says Stolen Fireworks AI Key Led to Trojanized Claude Code Extension Incident
stories.summary: The compromise of Anthropic's official Claude Code extension on Cursor's extension marketplace was the result of the theft of an access key that was exposed in the wake of a breach targeting Fireworks AI.
